200.description: Reviewed licensed JPEG; local preview only

get.description:
`map-context` rows; streets and buildings come with bounds instead of
geometry, for maps drawing them from `context-tiles`.
Parcel rows without footprints; maps draw them from `parcel-tiles`.

Index rows whose code starts with `q` anywhere in the territory, so a map
reading only its visible cells can still find a parcel outside the view.

200.description: Mapbox Vector Tile; layer `parcels`, property `id` only

get.description:
Published statements matching `q`, each with its evidence (E01).

`text` requires every word; `hybrid` fuses it with the optional semantic ranking and
answers with the full text alone without the embeddings service.

SourceRightsResponse.description: Reviewed rights of the source site (A19); `unknown` means not qualified yet.
SourceRightsResponse.title: SourceRightsResponse

CitedSourceResponse.description:
One site cited by a list of map features, with its reviewed rights (A24).

`host` is the reviewed registry host covering the site (or the page's own host when
no review lists it); a feature's rights are those of the entry covering its URL.
`url` and `name` are the first page of that site the list cites.
CitedSourceResponse.title: CitedSourceResponse

MapProvenance.description: Provenance of one map feature; its rights are in the list's `sources` (A24).
MapProvenance.title: MapProvenance

ProjectRelationResponse.description: The other project of a reviewed component link, never a merged identity.
ProjectRelationResponse.title: ProjectRelationResponse

ActivityMeasurementResponse.description: Ground change between two scenes of a parcel; a signal, never a progress share.
ActivityMeasurementResponse.title: ActivityMeasurementResponse

ActivityWindowResponse.description: Captured Sentinel-2 file window that one date of a measurement was computed from.
ActivityWindowResponse.title: ActivityWindowResponse

CancellationRetentionResponse.description: Developer retention on cancellation at the declared stage; a reading aid, not advice.
CancellationRetentionResponse.title: CancellationRetentionResponse

DeliveryOutcomeResponse.description: Whether a register reading proves the announced period was met or missed.
DeliveryOutcomeResponse.title: DeliveryOutcomeResponse

ObservedRangeResponse.description: Smallest and largest recorded value, as decimal text.
ObservedRangeResponse.title: ObservedRangeResponse

ObservedSalesGroupResponse.description: Recorded sales of one type; ranges cover the full-share sales only.
ObservedSalesGroupResponse.title: ObservedSalesGroupResponse

ObservedSalesLabelResponse.description: Reviewed ADREC sales label that selects the project's recorded sales.
ObservedSalesLabelResponse.title: ObservedSalesLabelResponse

ObservedSalesWindowResponse.description: Newest ADREC sales window of the territory; windows overlap and are never added.
ObservedSalesWindowResponse.title: ObservedSalesWindowResponse

ProjectConstructionActivityResponse.description: Latest satellite measurement of each measured parcel of the project.
ProjectConstructionActivityResponse.title: ProjectConstructionActivityResponse

ProjectDeclaredProgressResponse.description: Latest completion the authority register declares, dated by its inspection.
ProjectDeclaredProgressResponse.title: ProjectDeclaredProgressResponse

ProjectObservedSalesResponse.description: Recorded ADREC sales of the project's reviewed labels, by type, with ranges.
ProjectObservedSalesResponse.title: ProjectObservedSalesResponse

VerificationContradictionResponse.description: Two cited readings that disagree; no cause is inferred.
VerificationContradictionResponse.title: VerificationContradictionResponse

VerificationLinkResponse.description: Official register page an operator matched to the project; never read by the platform.
VerificationLinkResponse.title: VerificationLinkResponse

VerificationRegisterResponse.description: Latest project-scope register reading, values as published.
VerificationRegisterResponse.title: VerificationRegisterResponse

SourceSiteRightsResponse.description: One reviewed site of the source rights registry (A19); `unknown` means not qualified.
SourceSiteRightsResponse.title: SourceSiteRightsResponse
